Gundu Pedda Eshwaramma vs The Union Of India on 8 April,

 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.6342 of 2025

entities.text: Gundu Pedda Eshwaramma vs The Union Of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following prayer:
"WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of the Respondent No.7 in not considering the representations of the Petitioners 13/09/2022 31/03/2023 12/03/2024, 01/02/2025 and 03/02/2025 and not complying with the direction given by Respondent No.6 on 14/02/2025 communicated to Respondent No.7 vide Letter bearing Lr.No.G2/50/2022 as illegal arbitrary unconstitutional as the same is violative of Article 14 of Constitution of India and Consequently direct all the Respondents more particularly the Respondent No.7 to strictly follow the procedure laid down by law and also under the National Highways Act 1956 and Act No 30 of 2013 and the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways Government of India of Land acquisition for National Highway under National Highways Act 1956 under clause 3 3 iii with respect to Petitioners land admeasuring Ac.0-32 gts in Sy.No.206/A and 544 Sq yards in Sy.No.59 which is converted into non agricultural land situated at Chinthalapally Village Sangareddy Mandal and District proposed to be acquired by the Respondents authorities for Regional Ring Road under Notification dated 08/08/2023 And pass."

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Central Government counsel appearing for respondent No.1, learned Assistant Government Pleader NVSK,J for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 6, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.3 to 5 and Sri Murali Kumar Reddy, learned counsel appearing for the 7th respondent.
With the consent of the parties, the writ petition is being taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

3. Brief facts in this Writ Petition are that petitioner No.2 claims that she is the absolute owner and possessor of land admeasuring 455.2711 Sq. meters, equivalent to 544.50 Sq. yards in Sy.No.59,
situated at Chinthalapally village, Sangareddy mandal and district.
Petitioner No.2 land was converted from agriculture to non-agriculture land vide proceedings dated 07.01.2022 issued by the Tahsildar - cum - Joint Sub Registrar, Sangareddy mandal and district.

It is further submitted that for the purpose of Green-filed Expressway Project, in the stretch of land from Km.0 to Km.9.560 and Km.18.183 to Km.25.304, the respondents issued 3-A and 3-D Notifications on 08.08.2023 to acquire the land NVSK,J admeasuring Ac.47.16 gts., for regional ring road of Chinthalapally village in Sangareddy District.

It is further submitted that the petitioners made several representations to respondent Nos.6 and 7 to award compensation by treating their lands as non-agriculture lands and in reply to their representations respondent No.7 issued a letter dated 14.02.2025 stating that since Gundu Pedda Eshwaramma vs The Union Of India on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85928386/
1 their representations are pending the same may be considered at the time of passing the final Award.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Questioning the said letter dated 14.02.2025, petitioners filed the present Writ Petition.
4. Per contra, Sri Murali Kumar Reddy, learned counsel appearing for the 7th respondent submits that the present Writ Petition is in premature stage and that no Award has been passed till date.
Learned counsel further submits that if the representations are pending, respondent No.7 will consider the said representations and pass appropriate orders, in accordance with law.

Recording the submission made by learned counsel appearing on either side and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing respondent No.7 to dispose the representations made by the petitioners for determining the compensation based on the Nala proceedings dated 07.01.2022 issued by the Tahsildar - cum - Joint Sub Registrar, Sangareddy mandal and district and pass appropriate orders, strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible and also communicate the same to petitioners.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE N.V. SHRAVAN KUMAR April 08, 2025 PN NVSK,J THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE N.V. SHRAVAN KUMAR April 08, 2025 PN Gundu Pedda Eshwaramma vs The Union Of India on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85928386/
